title: Bayesian update under a noisy test

steps.annotation: Bayes' rule: the posterior in terms of likelihood, prior, and evidence

steps.formula: P(H \mid E) = \frac{P(E \mid H) \cdot P(H)}{P(E \mid H) \cdot P(H) + P(E \mid \neg H) \cdot P(\neg H)}
steps.annotation: Expand the denominator via the law of total probability
Even with a 95% accurate test, low base rate dominates the posterior

source: Standard worked example · Kahneman, Thinking Fast and Slow, ch. 16
